verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly advertise '100+ Supported Models' across text/vision/audio/embeddings, 'instant access to the most popular OSS models,' and 'fast, cost-effective access to leading open-source text models through OpenAI-compatible APIs' on serverless endpoints, and community evidence confirms at least one named family (gpt-oss-20b) is actually available/usable. This matches the story's ask for a broad open-weight catalog on shared serverless infrastructure.  Missing for 10: an explicit itemized list confirming Llama, Qwen, and DeepSeek specifically (only inferred from 'popular OSS models' claims plus one community example), and independent hands-on corroboration beyond a single pricing-focused community post.
